plan: Given my value is $3, my optimal strategy is to bid $0. This is because the prize value is low, and any positive bid would result in a loss if I win, as the third-highest bid will be at least $0.1. Rational bidders will bid above $3 if their value is higher, so I should avoid bidding to maximize long-term profit.

Given my value of $24, I should bid slightly above half of my value to maximize profit while minimizing the risk of overpaying. This strategy balances winning the auction without exceeding the value of the prize. Since bidders are rational, they will avoid bidding above their value. Therefore, bidding around $12 should be competitive enough to win against lower bids while keeping potential losses low if I lose.

Given my value of $11, I aim to maximize profit by bidding slightly below my value to account for rational bidding from others. With values randomly drawn, others may bid close to their values too. A bid of $10.9 ensures a chance to win if others bid lower, while minimizing loss if I win.
